Artera Harmony Federal Edition, powered by its advanced virtual agents, is a comprehensive suite of patient communication tools that transform patient experience through voice, text, and web. Integrating directly into the agency healthcare system's tech stack, including EHRs and third-party vendors, Artera Harmony Federal Edition supports the entire patient journey. The secure platform improves patient engagement by:
* Automating inbound and outbound communications to streamline critical workflows like pre-visit preparations, post-appointment follow-ups, prescription refills, and ongoing care coordination.
* Triaging patient inquiries 24/7 and automating administrative tasks, which reduces the burden on front-desk staff and boosts operational efficiency.
* Providing federal agency personnel with anywhere access to manage conversation workflows, customize communication templates, and oversee all patient communications.
* Integrating into patients' native phone, SMS/text, and email applications for a truly seamless experience.

In addition to pursuing FedRAMP High Authorization, Artera’s best-in-class InfoSec approach keeps data safe, compliant and built for healthcare. Artera Harmony Federal Edition, including virtual agents, meets top industry standards – SOC 2 Type 2, HITRUST Certified and is HIPAA compliant. 

Artera Harmony Federal Edition is brought to you by Artera Government Solutions, an Artera business unit. Artera is trusted by 900+ provider organizations to engage 100 million patients annually. 

Learn more at https://artera.io/federal-healthcare-communication/.
